touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Warmingham qualifies as a local detour through Stepped cross base in the churchyard of St Leonard's Church and THE CHURCH OF ST LEONARD. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Warmingham: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Warmingham offers Stepped cross base in the churchyard of St Leonard's Church, THE CHURCH OF ST LEONARD, MEDIEVAL CROSS IN GROUNDS OF ST LEONARD'S CHURCH within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
